title: Intermediate compact-support reduction tower and exchange substitution
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be the Noetherian adic datum with finite perfect quotients $P_n=A/I^n$, completed coefficient sheaves $A_T$ and strict reductions of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Supply a compatible compactification tower for separated finite-type maps $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow hZ$ [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]:
$$X\xrightarrow a\overline X\xrightarrow p\overline Y\xrightarrow qZ,\qquad Y\xrightarrow i\overline Y.$$
Put $U=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$, with quasi-compact opens $c:X\hookrightarrow U$, $b:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $bc=a$, and proper $p_Y:U\to Y$, $p_Yc=f$. Extension by zero is the exact localized ringed-site functor [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ be intrinsically complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with compatible bounded-below etale-origin witnesses $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*L_n\cong K_n$, $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].

The intermediate object must use completed compact support. The following notation specifies it and its maps. Under the constant/completed equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], write $\bar K=\operatorname{Res}_XK$, $\mathcal R_TN=(N\otimes_A^LP_n)_n$ for the actual derived strict reduction, $L_T=R\lim$, and $C_T=L_T\mathcal R_T$ with its completion unit $\eta$ [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. Use the constant-coefficient operations [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. On ambient constant-coefficient complexes put $B_f=Rp_{Y*}J_c$ and $B_h=Rq_*J_i$, and on strict towers put $F_f=R_{p_Y}J_c$, $F_h=R_qJ_i$. Define $\widehat B_f=C_YB_f$ and $\widehat B_h=C_ZB_h$ on complete inputs. For completed-ring objects use the equivalent functors transported through the specified equivalence. Set $\bar H=\widehat B_f\bar K$, and let $H$ be its corresponding completed-ring object. There is a canonical natural identification
$$\bar H\cong Rp_{Y*}C_UJ_c\bar K\cong L_YF_fM,\qquad M=\mathcal R_X\bar K\cong\operatorname{Res}_XK_\bullet.$$
Here $C_UJ_c\bar K\cong L_UJ_cM$ is the completion presentation of [lem-sf-cbc-extension-zero-completion]; the second arrow is the normalized proper direct-image/limit comparison [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison]. Denote their composite by $\mu_{f,K}:\bar H\cong L_YF_fM$.

The object $H$ is intrinsically complete. Its finite reductions have the specified natural $P_n$-linear comparisons and witnesses
$$H_n\cong Rp_{Y*,n}c_!K_n\cong\nu_Y^*(Rp^{\mathrm{et}}_{Y*,n}c^{\mathrm{et}}_!L_n).$$
The rightmost complex is bounded below separately for every $n$; no common lower bound is required. The comparisons commute with quotient transitions and augmentations. In constant coefficients they form the actual derived strict-tower isomorphism
$$\theta_{f,K}:\mathcal R_Y\bar H\xrightarrow{\sim}F_fM.$$
More precisely, let $t_f:\mathcal R_YB_f\to F_f\mathcal R_X$ be the diagram-site counit-tensor projection for $p_Y$ followed by the strict open-tensor comparison. Then
$$\theta_{f,K}\,\mathcal R_Y(\eta_{B_f\bar K})=t_{f,\bar K},\qquad
\mu_{f,K}=L_Y(\theta_{f,K})\eta_{\bar H}.$$
The analogous comparisons are used for $h$ and every indicated base change.

For $g:Z'\to Z$ let $g_Y:Y'\to Y$, $g_X:X'\to X$ and all ambient base changes be induced from the supplied tower. Put $g_c^*=C_{Z'}g^*$ and similarly at the other corners. Define $e_f:G_{g_Y}F_f\to F'_fG_{g_X}$ and $e_h:G_gF_h\to F'_hG_{g_Y}$ on actual constant-coefficient strict towers to be the ordered proper square mate followed by the proper image of the open unit-mate [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus, lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. Let $x_f:g_{Y,c}^*\widehat B_f\to\widehat B'_fg_{X,c}^*$, and $x_h:g_c^*\widehat B_h\to\widehat B'_hg_{Y,c}^*$, be the completed ordinary compact-support exchanges: apply $C$ to the ordinary proper-mate/open-mate composite, using the completion units to identify the source and target with these displayed objects. In particular the open target is completed; these are the maps with completed target in the upstream construction, transported through the coefficient equivalence. Then, using $\theta$ and $\mu$ and the unit-normalized pullback reduction [lem-sf-cbc-completed-pullback-unit-tower],
$$x_h(H)=L_{Z'}((e_hF_f)_M),\qquad
\widehat B'_h(x_f(K))=L_{Z'}((F'_he_f)_M).$$
These equalities include all source and target identifications, are natural in $K$, and concern specified strict-tower morphisms before evaluation. They do not assert that ordinary $c_!$ preserves completeness or that $c_!R\lim\cong R\lim J_c$ for arbitrary towers.

proof.text: Lean implementation of the finite and assembly clauses (X8, 2026-10-25): identify finiteProperProjection componentwise with AdicCoefficientDatum.finiteProjection by the mate/counit equation. The existing finiteProjection_isIso and finiteUnits give finiteComparison_isIso, without using finiteAndIntrinsic. Identify the two constants-to-functions coefficient comparisons by their sheafification-unit specification; cancelling the coefficient isomorphisms proves finiteScalarSquare. Scalar restriction along these coefficient isomorphisms is an equivalence, so the inverse-mate equivalence lemma proves finiteScalarOpenInverse_isIso. The existing finiteScalarMap_unit at the identity ring map proves originScalarUnit. For retainedOrigins, use exactly finiteAntecedent(W_n) and define its witness isomorphism as finiteOriginSupport followed by the inverse of the composite of finiteComparison with finiteScalarSupport. The proper origin map is invertible by hR_isIso and the exact open comparison; cancellation proves its normalization equation. Move finiteAndIntrinsic after retainedOrigins: transport completionUnits completeness across ringSupportRestriction and restriction_complete, use finiteComparison_isIso, and forget the normalization equation of retainedOrigins. Thus no cycle between the two origin assertions remains. For ringReducedUnit, use rho_unit and strictUnits to identify the constant scalar restriction of the reduced ring unit with an invertible map. Transport through rho and reflect the isomorphism through exact strict-tower scalar restriction; conservativity on derived categories follows from homology. Finally completedSupportIntermediateTower assembles completionUnits, reconstructionNormalization, finiteAndIntrinsic and retainedOrigins. The finiteUnits conjunction is assembled from the strictly simpler component statements finiteOpenTensor_isIso and finiteRingUnit_isIso. The two component holes finiteOpenTensor_isIso and finiteRingUnit_isIso are proved as recorded in their own nodes. The only remaining hole in this item module is strictFiniteCoherence. The ambient helper holes remain attached to the relocated ambient node.

proof.text: For the first successive substitution specialize exchangeSubstitution for h to the completed support of f, then apply naturality of the strict exchange to theta_f. For the second use naturality of mu_h-prime on the completed exchange of f, apply the strict reduction square completedExchange_reduction for f, and apply the strict support functor for h-prime followed by Rlim to this equality. Functor.map_comp and associativity finish the calculation. Finally expand exchangeTarget: firstTarget and secondSource agree by Functor.map_comp and associativity. This proves twoSubstitutions from a single-square reduction theorem, without assuming faithfulness of Rlim.

split_report.summary: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: ordinary extension by zero need not preserve intrinsic completeness, even for finite etale-origin reductions. Replaced the intermediate ordinary compact-support object and arbitrary open/limit interchange by completed compact support, with its unit-normalized strict reduction. Proved the two successive exchange substitutions by strict tensor/mate squares and naturality. No new nodes; all prerequisites already exist. The report gives an explicit strictly henselian trait counterexample and flags the conflicting existing product/completeness assertions.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q85-4845fa3f2 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, every cited statement, the blueprint proof of thm-cbc-complete-proetale (main-20261015) and Stacks 099N. There are no new nodes. The S1 statement correction is justified by a real source error (E7): the blueprint infers that j_!K is complete from exactness. I checked the worker's strictly henselian trait counterexample myself. On V=Spec colim(R×k^m), the compatible sections ℓ^m at the points v_m have a limit that is not locally zero near s_∞ on any pro-étale cover, so j_!Z_ℓ is not complete. With h=id and p_Y=id this falsifies the old claim that H=Rp_{Y*}c_!K is complete. The upstream CompletedExchange.lean:266-293 documents the same failure. The corrected item uses completed compact support C_Y(Rp_{Y*}J_cK̄) ≅ Rp_{Y*}C_UJ_cK̄ (Stacks 099N(3)) ≅ L_YF_fM. It keeps every true clause (P_n-linear reductions, witnesses with bounds separate for each n, strict θ, both substitution equalities) and adds no hypothesis. Steps 1-3 and 5-11 check against the cited statements: perfect-quotient projection, comparison-direct-image mate (qcqs because proper, D+), localized strict tensor descent, exchange-tensor coherence and pullback-unit-tower (i)/(ii). There is no SGA, no duplicate node and no circularity. FIX, one repair: Step 4 justified μ=L(θ)η by 'its projections are exactly those of Step 2', inferring equality of maps into Rlim from projections (E5). I rewrote it explicitly: naturality of a, then the constant-tower normalization χ, then naturality of the projection map along the augmentation ΔA→(P_n) with identity at the unit coefficient, then L. Three existing proof_deps were added to Step 4's uses. Maintainer note: the parent thm-cbc-complete-proetale states the target Rp'_*j'_!Lg'^*_comp K with an inverse j'_! derived-limit comparison. That fails for g=id on the same example and needs the completed-target form; its Step 7 must be re-split against this corrected item. lem-cbc-ringed-open-extension-products (j_! commutes with arbitrary products) is false, and so are its consumers lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison and lem-cbc-complete-proetale-strict-tower-realization.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

lean.statement: theorem completedSupportIntermediateTower {X Y Z : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h] (T : Compactification.Triangle f h) [QuasiCompact T.cf.i] [QuasiCompact T.cg.i] (K : d.derived X) (hK : d.TowerComplete X K) (W : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEtaleOriginWitness X (ProEtale.PbcQuotient d n) ((d.reduction X n).obj K)) : IsComplete d Y ((completed d T.cf.i T.cf.g).obj ((res d X).obj K)) ∧ d.TowerComplete Y ((ringSupport d T.cf.i T.cf.g).obj K) ∧ IsIso (theta d T.cf.i T.cf.g) ∧ IsIso (mu d T.cf.i T.cf.g) ∧ (properCompletedOpen d T.cf.i T.cf.g ≫ limitCompletedOpen d T.cf.i T.cf.g = mu d T.cf.i T.cf.g) ∧ (reducedUnit d T.cf.i T.cf.g ≫ theta d T.cf.i T.cf.g = ordinaryReduction d T.cf.i T.cf.g) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (finiteComparison d T.cf.i T.cf.g n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ V : FiniteEtaleOriginWitness Y (ProEtale.PbcQuotient d n) ((d.reduction Y n).obj ((ringSupport d T.cf.i T.cf.g).obj K)), ∃ e : V.complex = finiteAntecedent d T.cf.i T.cf.g n (W n).complex, V.iso.hom ≫ (finiteOriginToConstant Y (ProEtale.PbcQuotient d n)).map ((finiteComparison d T.cf.i T.cf.g n).app K) ≫ (finiteScalarSupport d T.cf.i T.cf.g n).app ((d.reduction X n).obj K) = eqToHom (congrArg (fun L ↦ (etaleOriginComparison Y (ProEtale.PbcQuotient d n)).obj L.obj) e) ≫ finiteOriginSupport d T.cf.i T.cf.g K n (W n))
lean.note: The assertion is distributed over the recorded declarations. completedSupportIntermediateTower assembles the supplied tower and completed input; strictFiniteCoherence states strict transition/augmentation and finite-evaluation coherence; reconstructionNormalization fixes the two presentations and mu; exchangeSubstitution and twoSubstitutions give the natural exchange equalities with every endpoint identification. Helper definitions use the canonical adjunction mates, actual completion units and normalized coefficient comparisons. No ordinary extension/limit commutation or completeness preservation is asserted.
